SPELL_ABILITY.LOCALISED_TEXT: エンチャント（クリーチャー）

STATIC_ABILITY.CONTINUOUS_ACTION: local parent = EffectSource():GetParent() if parent ~= nil then parent:GetCurrentCharacteristics():Bool_Set( CHARACTERISTIC_FIRST_STRIKE, 1 ) end

local parent = EffectSource():GetParent() if parent ~= nil then local filter = ClearFilter() filter:Add(FE_TYPE, OP_IS, CARD_TYPE_ENCHANTMENT ) filter:Add( FE_CONTROLLER, OP_IS, EffectController()) local number = filter:Count() parent:GetCurrentCharacteristics():Power_Add( number ) parent:GetCurrentCharacteristics():Toughness_Add( number ) end
